description: SET ADDRESS OF (data-pointer assignment), ISO §2023:14.9.39 Format 7 + §2023:8.4.3.11 ADDRESS OF - introduced 2002. LIVE (Phase-4b increment 2, DEVLOG 617): both directions - SET p TO ADDRESS OF x (the sender form; x's record is forced onto a StorageCell so a CellPointer window can alias it) and SET ADDRESS OF b TO p (SR18 - the receiver shall be BASED; GR12-13 snapshot assignment). Binder-side registry gate (a grammar predicate would fall through to the other SET alternatives and mis-diagnose).

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SAMX1.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 X PIC X(5) VALUE "HELLO".
01 P USAGE POINTER.
01 B PIC X(5) BASED.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    SET P TO ADDRESS OF X.
    SET ADDRESS OF B TO P.
    STOP RUN.
